name: Shift
title: Shifting Signs
description: Signs that change when unobserved, warnings that contradict themselves, directions that lead everywhere and nowhere.
greeting_variants: *sign reads: 'WELCOME' then 'GO AWAY' then 'HELP' then gibberish*
The signs speak. When they want. What they want.
*arrow points left, then right, then up, then through itself*
Reading is dangerous here. Understanding more so.
*sign drips like liquid* WARNING: DO NOT... [rest illegible]
I paint. The signs change. I paint again. They change again.
Words have power. Here, they have too much.

dialog_tree.text: I was Ward. Am Ward? Will be? The signs... I paint truth. Reality... changes it. Now I am Shift. The signs and I... merged. I feel them change. Want them to help. They want... to be honest? But honesty shifts here.

*moment of clarity* Ward. Yes. Saved lives. Warning signs. Clear. True. Then... the Void. Needed signs here too. Painted truth. But truth... moves. Shifts. Now I'm... part of the message. The medium. The confusion.

party_reactions.shift: *sad* You. Me. Truth. Lies. Both. Neither.

dialog_tree.text: They try to warn. To guide. But meaning... slides. 'DANGER' becomes 'WELCOME' becomes 'MEMORY' becomes nothing. The Void corrupts communication. Intent. I fight. Keep painting. Signs keep... becoming.

options.text: How can I trust any sign?

dialog_tree.text: *laughs, sound like scratching on wood* Control? I am controlled. By the changing. The shifting. I paint CLEAR. WARN. REALITY makes it... else. I am brush. Paint. Not artist. Not anymore.

mini_quest.title: Stabilize the Warnings
mini_quest.description: Help Shift create signs that resist the Void's corruption to guide lost travelers.
objectives: Find a stable point for anchoring
Test the signs against Void shifting

ambient_barks: *sign spontaneously changes* No! Was clear! Was TRUE!
The words... they want to mean something. I help them.
*reading shifting sign* Danger. Safe. Danger. Both.
I remember... clear messages. Miss them.
*whispering to sign* Stay true. Please. For them.

cross_zone_references.capital: Clear signs. True signs. Miss. Every moment.
cross_zone_references.chroma_tower: Tower has order. Structure. Signs there... obey. Envy.

ward_capital.response: *gentle* You stayed true. I... became else.

time_of_day.day: Signs slightly more stable, more readable
time_of_day.night: Chaos, signs shift constantly, gibberish predominates

world_state_triggers.sign_stable: Brief joy: 'Held! It held! For a moment!'
